0.0: A jewel that resembles a cat's eye, aptly called a Cat's Eye Jewel. This powerful jewel has the ability to mesmerize anyone that looks upon it. It is at its best when adorned by a beautiful woman. There's a saying that goes, no one is immune from falling head over heels for anyone wearing a Cat's Eye Jewel. Perfect for anyone trying to seduce someone...
0.1: It is known as the heart of the desert, rumored to be formed by the very heat of the desert sun. It's solid, it's beautiful, it's...Lidium. Quite a surprise, isn't it?
